object_context: At one fixed lattice spacing in the explicit Shen-Zhu-Zhu strong-coupling SU(N) Wilson lattice theory, determine whether the exact infinite-volume measure obtained as the thermodynamic limit of the finite-volume Wilson measures inherits Osterwalder-Schrader reflection positivity for bounded continuous positive-time gauge-invariant cylinder sources, without changing action, boundary condition, reflection, gauge sector, measure, or normalization.
qoi_success_contract: Source-bind the finite-volume SZZ measure as the Wilson plaquette measure on periodic lattices in the selected positive-beta strong-coupling regime.
Source-bind finite-volume reflection positivity/physical positivity for the matching Wilson action and a compatible finite-volume reflection geometry.
Use a reflection-compatible cofinal subsequence and bind SZZ convergence strongly enough that its limit is the same mu^ym_{N,beta}.
For every bounded continuous positive-time cylinder F in scope, verify conjugate(theta F) F is a bounded continuous cylinder so finite-volume nonnegativity passes through weak convergence.

Keep gauge invariance, reflection invariance, positive transfer/Hamiltonian identification, covariance-to-transfer moments, support-distance-to-time geometry, lattice-spacing uniformity, RG transport, and continuum spectral identification as separate coordinates.

scope.dimension: d >= 2 as source permits; Yang-Mills root relevance d=4 only
scope.coupling: prospectively restrict to 0 < beta < 1/[16(d-1)] unless primary sources force a narrower overlap

structural_coordinates: finite periodic Wilson lattice Gibbs measures
fixed Euclidean time reflection compatible with an even temporal torus
local/cylinder weak convergence on a common compact product configuration space
same-measure identity across finite-volume subsequence and SZZ infinite-volume limit
gauge invariance and reflection invariance typed separately from reflection positivity
equivalent_formulations: For every bounded continuous F supported in a fixed positive-time half-space cylinder algebra, show lim_L Q_L(F)=Q_infty(F)>=0 along a reflection-compatible cofinal sequence.
Show the positive cone of OS quadratic forms on the local cylinder algebra is closed under the exact local weak limit defining the SZZ infinite-volume state.

solved_near_solved_analogues.method: closedness of a scalar nonnegative inequality under convergence of expectations of bounded continuous observables
transfer_assumptions: test observable belongs to convergence class
disanalogies: does not create reflection positivity if finite-volume inequality is for a different action/reflection

solved_near_solved_analogues.method: factor plaquette weights across a reflection plane and prove positive/physical positivity for Wilson gauge action
transfer_assumptions: positive beta or theorem-specific coupling scope
disanalogies: finite-volume positivity does not itself identify the SZZ thermodynamic limit

solved_near_solved_analogues.method: same-measure L2 density plus OS-seminorm continuity
disanalogies: open PR #225 proposal/shadow only; not strict authority; presupposes the same-measure RP coordinate now under test

method_transfer_matrix.shared_structure: one bounded continuous scalar test functional per cylinder source
method_transfer_matrix.target_falsifier: find F for which reflected product is outside the convergence class or finite-volume reflections/actions do not match

method_transfer_matrix.shared_structure: plaquette Wilson Gibbs weight and coordinate reflection
method_transfer_matrix.target_falsifier: source theorem needs boundary/action/gauge fixing different from SZZ finite-volume family

cross_domain_analogy_scan.analogy: positive-semidefinite matrices are closed under entrywise limits
cross_domain_analogy_scan.common_abstraction: nonnegative quadratic inequalities survive convergence when every tested quadratic coordinate converges
cross_domain_analogy_scan.difference_witness: OS reflection couples reflected and unreflected local fields and still needs common source state/reflection; matrix analogy supplies no lattice-gauge theorem

same_context_expert_cell.pre_candidate_objection: Do not infer a transfer operator or Hamiltonian merely from limiting reflection positivity.
Finite-volume RP must match Wilson action, sign, lattice geometry and reflection plane exactly; even-time subsequence may be necessary.
Weak convergence passes only bounded continuous local functionals; verify whole-sequence or subsequence limit identity.
Even passed RP is upstream of the covariance-to-transfer-moment and excited-spectrum gap steps.
Fixed-cutoff positivity supplies no lattice-spacing-uniform physical spectral lower bound.
Open PR #225 and PR #62 may guide routing but cannot act as strict authority; preserve local-vs-gluing separation and zero independent-review credit.
